_readme: Seasonal hub pages built by build.py from the ranked category pages, so picks update whenever a page does. Gift pages pick the best-scoring product per device family inside the price band (at least min_reviews reviews and min_rating stars, no unbranded listings). Set "enabled": false to drop a page from the build and sitemap after the season. "link_from" (YYYY-MM-DD) keeps a page live and in the sitemap but hides every on-site link to it until that date; a tiny script reveals the links on the day, no rebuild needed. "link_until" hides the links again from that date on (the page stays live, indexed and in the sitemap). Holiday deal pages: the black_friday block plus each entry of "holidays" (slug, label, year, link_from, link_until, key_dates [{label, date}], dates_note, deal_name, faq_heading, title, subtitle, intro, faq). Rule: link_from = holiday minus 7 days, link_until = the Monday after the weekend that follows the holiday. Set "noindex": true to keep a page built and linked but out of Google and the sitemap. gift_skip_pages / gift_skip_asins keep hobbyist gear (SDR sticks, ESP32 boards) and parts-only items (replacement sensors) off the gift pages.

gifts.label: Smart Home Gifts Under $50
gifts.title: Best Smart Home Gifts Under $50 (2026)
gifts.subtitle: The highest-rated smart home device in each category that costs $50 or less.
gifts.intro: Every gift here is the top-scoring product under $50 in one of our ranked device categories, from smart plugs and bulbs to sensors, buttons, and trackers. We score each one on star rating, number of reviews, and the features that matter, and we only picked products rated 4.2 stars or higher with at least 100 reviews. The Works with icons show which smart home systems each gift fits, so check them against what the person already uses.

faq.q: What is a good smart home gift under $50?
faq.a: For someone new to smart homes, a smart plug or a pack of smart bulbs is the easiest win: they work over Wi-Fi with Alexa or Google and need no hub. For someone who already has a system, a sensor, button, or tracker that matches their hub is a better fit.

faq.q: How do I know it will work with their system?
faq.a: Look at the Works with icons on each pick. If you don't know what they use, Wi-Fi and Matter devices are the safest choices, because they work with the most platforms. Zigbee and Z-Wave devices need a compatible hub.

faq.q: What if they already have it?
faq.a: Every gift links to Amazon, where you can add a gift receipt at checkout. Smart plugs, bulbs, and sensors are hard to own too many of, so they make safe picks.

gifts.label: Smart Home Gifts Under $100
gifts.title: Best Smart Home Gifts Under $100 (2026)
gifts.subtitle: The highest-rated smart home device between $50 and $100 in each category.
gifts.intro: Between $50 and $100 is where smart home gifts get serious: video doorbells, smart thermostats, starter kits, hubs, and smart locks. Every pick is the top-scoring product in that price range in one of our ranked categories, rated 4.2 stars or higher with at least 100 reviews. The Works with icons show which systems each one fits.

faq.q: What is the best smart home gift under $100?
faq.a: For most people, a video doorbell or a smart thermostat, because they get used every day. If they're just starting out, a hub-free starter kit, like a Lutron Caseta dimmer kit or a set of Matter plugs, is an easy first step.

faq.q: Should I match the brand they already own?
faq.a: If you know their system, yes: pick a device with their system's icon. Matter devices work with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant, so they're the safe choice when you're not sure.

faq.q: Where are the gifts under $50?
faq.a: They're on our Smart Home Gifts Under $50 page. This page only lists picks between $50 and $100, so the two pages don't repeat each other.

gifts.label: Smart Home Gifts: Money No Object
gifts.title: Best Smart Home Gifts, Money No Object (2026)
gifts.subtitle: The most premium top-rated pick in every smart home category we rank, with no price limit.
gifts.intro: For the person who has everything, or the gift you'd buy yourself. In each device category we rank, we took the products that score within 15 points of the category's best, rated 4.2 stars or higher with at least 50 reviews, and picked the most premium one. Price was never a limit, but every pick still has to rank near the top on our scores. Check the Works with icons against the system they already use.

faq.q: Are the most expensive smart home devices worth it?
faq.a: Sometimes. Premium models usually add better build quality, more sensors, longer range, or support for more systems. But we only picked products that also score near the top of their category on ratings and features, so nothing here is expensive for the sake of it.

faq.q: What's the best high-end smart home gift for someone who has everything?
faq.a: Pick something that upgrades a system they already use: a premium smart lock, a floodlight camera, a mesh router, or a top-end thermostat. The Works with icons tell you whether it fits their Alexa, Google, Apple Home, or Home Assistant setup.

faq.q: Will a premium device work with their existing system?
faq.a: Check the Works with icons. Matter devices work with the widest range of systems. Zigbee and Z-Wave devices need a compatible hub, and some premium brands work best inside their own app.

black_friday.label: Black Friday Smart Home Deals 2026
black_friday.title: Black Friday Smart Home Deals 2026: The Price to Beat
black_friday.subtitle: Our Best Overall and Best Budget pick on every page, with the regular price we last saw, so you can tell a real Black Friday deal from a fake one.
black_friday.intro: Black Friday falls on November 27, 2026, and Cyber Monday on November 30. Smart home prices on Amazon usually start dropping the week before, especially Amazon's own Echo and Ring devices, Google Nest, and big brands like TP-Link and eufy. The trick is knowing what a device normally costs, so below is every one of our top picks with the regular price we captured. If the Black Friday price is lower, it's a real deal. If it isn't, wait or buy something else.

faq.q: When is Black Friday 2026?
faq.a: Black Friday is Friday, November 27, 2026, the day after Thanksgiving. Cyber Monday is November 30, 2026. Amazon usually starts early Black Friday pricing on smart home devices the week before.

faq.q: Which smart home devices get the biggest Black Friday discounts?
faq.a: Amazon's own devices (Echo speakers, Echo Show, Ring doorbells and cameras, Blink) usually see the deepest cuts, along with Google Nest and multi-pack smart plugs and bulbs. Niche Z-Wave and Zigbee gear rarely goes on sale, so buy it when you need it.

faq.q: Is it better to buy on Black Friday or Cyber Monday?
faq.a: Black Friday week usually has the widest selection. Cyber Monday often repeats the same prices and adds a few. If your pick hits a price you're happy with, buy it, because popular bundles can sell out.

faq.q: Should I buy a bundle or a single device?
faq.a: Bundles like a doorbell plus chime, or a camera plus an Echo Show, are often where the real savings are. Check that you'll use every piece; a bundle is only a deal if you wanted the extras.

holidays.label: Veterans Day Smart Home Deals 2026
holidays.dates_note: Veterans Day sales usually run through the weekend that follows, and Amazon often starts early Black Friday pricing the same month.
holidays.faq_heading: Veterans Day smart home deal questions
holidays.title: Veterans Day Smart Home Deals 2026: The Price to Beat
holidays.subtitle: Our Best Overall and Best Budget pick on every page, with the regular Amazon price we recorded, so you can tell whether a Veterans Day sale price is a real discount.
holidays.intro: Veterans Day is Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Plenty of retailers run sales around it, and it lands about two weeks before Black Friday, so it's an early look at holiday smart home pricing. Below is every one of our top picks with the regular price we last captured. If the sale price is lower, it's a real discount. If it isn't, Black Friday (November 27) is close.

faq.q: When is Veterans Day 2026?
faq.a: Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Sales tied to it often run from the weekend before through the weekend after.

faq.q: Should I buy smart home gear on Veterans Day or wait for Black Friday?
faq.a: If a device you want is already below the regular price we list, buying now is reasonable. Black Friday (November 27, 2026) usually brings the widest run of smart home discounts, especially on Amazon, Ring, Blink and Google Nest devices, so if the price hasn't moved, waiting two weeks costs you little.

faq.q: Do Z-Wave and Zigbee devices go on sale for Veterans Day?
faq.a: Rarely. Niche protocol gear from brands like Zooz, Inovelli and Aqara tends to hold its price through most sales. Buy it when you need it, and save sale-watching for the big-brand Wi-Fi devices.

faq.q: How do I know if a Veterans Day deal is real?
faq.a: Compare the sale price with the regular price in our cheat sheet. A crossed-out list price on a listing isn't proof of a discount; the price the device actually sold for in recent weeks is.

holidays.title: Christmas Smart Home Deals 2026: Last-Minute Picks and the Price to Beat
holidays.subtitle: Our Best Overall and Best Budget pick on every page, with the regular Amazon price we recorded, so you can tell whether a Christmas sale price is a real discount.
holidays.intro: Christmas Day is Friday, December 25, 2026. Most Black Friday prices are gone by mid-December, but some smart home devices stay discounted right up to the holiday, and last-minute shoppers mostly care about what still arrives in time. Below is every one of our top picks with the regular price we captured. If today's price is lower, it's a real deal. Each button opens the live listing, where Amazon shows the current delivery date.

faq.q: When is Christmas 2026?
faq.a: Friday, December 25, 2026. Shipping cutoffs land in the days before, so order early in the week of December 21 if you need it under the tree.

faq.q: What's a good last-minute smart home gift?
faq.a: Something that works without a hub: a Wi-Fi smart plug, a smart bulb, a video doorbell or an indoor camera. Check our gift pages for the best pick under $50 and under $100 in each device type.

faq.q: Are Christmas prices lower than Black Friday?
faq.a: Usually not. Black Friday and Cyber Monday tend to have the lowest prices of the season. Some devices drop again in mid-December, so compare today's price with the regular price in our cheat sheet.

faq.q: What if the gift needs a hub?
faq.a: Z-Wave and Zigbee devices need a hub or controller to work. If you're not sure what the recipient uses, pick a Wi-Fi or Matter device; Matter works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings.

Below is every one of our top picks with the regular price we captured. If today's price is lower, it's a real deal. If it isn't, the regular price is still fair, and our full rankings show the alternatives.

faq.q: Are there smart home deals after Christmas?
faq.a: Some. After-Christmas and New Year sales usually run from December 26 into early January. They're generally smaller than Black Friday, so compare each price with the regular price in our cheat sheet.

faq.q: I got a smart speaker for Christmas. What should I add first?
faq.a: Smart plugs and smart bulbs are the easiest add-ons and work with Alexa and Google Assistant without a hub. If you want to grow into a bigger setup, look at Matter devices, which work across Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings.

faq.q: Is January a good time to start a Home Assistant setup?
faq.a: It's as good as any. Start with a Zigbee or Z-Wave coordinator from our hubs and controllers pages, then add sensors and switches over time. Protocol gear rarely goes on sale, so there's no reason to wait for a deal.

faq.q: How do I know if a New Year deal is real?
faq.a: Compare the sale price with the regular price in our cheat sheet. A crossed-out list price on a listing isn't proof of a discount; the price the device actually sold for in recent weeks is.
